interpretation: A final conditional-permission claim disagrees with the same-passage first-stage applicability or prerequisite proposal. Both proposals are fallible. A disagreement is a source-review priority, not proof that either stage is correct or a clinical error rate. Saved judgments, source inputs and production behavior are unchanged. Reference labels and overall model outcomes are withheld from these review packets.

final_proposal.conclusion: The patient's recurrent uncertain blackouts separated by at least 24 hours, with 9.99 event-free years, may meet the criteria for a conditional licence, subject to at least annual review, taking into account information provided by an appropriate expert.
final_proposal.guideline_quote:
A person should not drive for 10 years 
following two or more blackouts of 
undetermined nature separated by a 24-
hour period.
A person is not fit to hold an unconditional 
licence:
•	 if the person has experienced blackouts 
that cannot be diagnosed as syncope, 
seizure or another condition.
If there has been a single blackout or more 
than one blackout within a 24-hour period, 
a conditional licence may be considered 
by the driver licensing authority subject to 
at least annual review, taking into account 
information provided by an appropriate 
specialist as to whether the following 
criterion is met:
•	 there have been no further blackouts for 
at least 5 years.
If there have been two or more blackouts 
separated by at least 24 hours, a 
conditional licence may be considered by 
the driver licensing authority subject to at 
least annual review, taking into account 
information provided by an appropriate 
specialist as to whether the following 
criterion is met:
•	 there have been no further blackouts for 
at least 10 years.
